adapter.goal: Map Material Select / exposed-dropdown facts into the shared component parity packet so field-family overlay work can produce repair, hardening, and gate queues.
source_precedence: Material spec and Material Web for Select visual intent, option richness, and token vocabulary
Compose Material3 for exposed-dropdown state, menu anchoring, touch, and toolkit semantics
Material UI for web-facing Select/Menu defaults and focus behavior
Base UI Select for headless a11y part composition
Fret shadcn Select for in-tree overlay/test_id/gate structure, not Material visuals

limitations: This first Select packet is a harness baseline, not a full Material Select parity claim.
The packet relies on existing Material Select diagnostics scripts and source wiring; fresh bundle/layout captures must replace the live-measurement rows before component repair work starts.

Material Select has no single upstream reference. This fixture uses Material Web for select-specific API/chrome, Compose Material3 for exposed-dropdown state and menu patterns, MUI for web-facing Select/Menu defaults, and Base UI for headless select semantics.
The current fixture does not compare upstream DOM geometry because no Material Select upstream DOM snapshot is attached yet.

facts: A Select needs stable trigger/input, popup/listbox, option/item, and selected-state surfaces for automation.
Material Web select options expose display text, typeahead text, supporting text, and selected item state as component-level facts.
Base UI Select splits trigger, popup, list, item, item text, icon, and indicator into stable headless parts.
Select::test_id stamps the trigger semantics and chrome with the caller-provided id.
The listbox derives a stable '<base>-listbox' id from the trigger id, falling back to 'material3-select-listbox' when no base id exists.
SelectItem::test_id stamps option semantics and derives '<item>.chrome' for the list item chrome.
The Material3 gallery snippet exposes default, typeahead, unclamped-width, rich-option, and transformed-positioning probes.

checks.expected: Material Select should expose stable trigger, derived listbox, option, and option chrome ids for diagnostics and future packet predicates.

promotion.reason: Selector stability is a recipe-level prerequisite for field-family packet automation.

parts.label: Material 3 Select combobox, listbox, focus restore, and option semantics

facts: A closed Select trigger behaves like a combobox-style field control and reports expanded state when open.
Opening the Select exposes a listbox-like popup with selectable options, disabled option state, and selected state.
Dismissing the popup should restore focus to the trigger instead of losing focus to the page.
Headless Select implementations keep trigger, popup/list, and item semantics independently addressable.
Fret Material3 Select sets SemanticsRole::ComboBox on the trigger and SemanticsRole::ListBox on the popup.
Fret Material3 Select sets SemanticsRole::ListBoxOption on each option with selected, pos_in_set, and set_size metadata.
The a11y parity diag script asserts typeahead navigation, Escape dismissal, and focus restoration to the trigger.

checks.expected: A fresh Material Select a11y bundle should prove trigger expanded state, popup/listbox presence, focused option after typeahead, disabled option semantics, and focus restoration after Escape.

promotion.reason: The invariant is an interaction/a11y flow and must be proven through a scripted bundle, not source inspection alone.

parts.label: Material 3 Select typeahead delay and disabled-item skipping

facts: Material Web exposes select option typeahead text and a select-level typeahead delay behavior.
Toolkit menus and exposed dropdowns should skip disabled items during keyboard navigation and typeahead.
Typeahead buffering is interaction policy, not a core rendering mechanism.
Select::typeahead_delay_ms defaults to 200ms and is passed into the listbox roving focus typeahead helper.
The gallery exposes 200ms, 500ms, and 1000ms delay controls plus enabled and disabled options.
The typeahead diag script asserts that buffered key presses respect the configured delay and skip disabled items.

checks.expected: The Material Select typeahead delay should have a focused scripted repro that can distinguish buffered typing from expired typing.

promotion.reason: The current script should be promoted to a packet-backed regression gate after a fresh capture is attached.

parts.label: Material 3 Select menu width floor and transformed-anchor positioning

facts: Material Select menus are anchored to the trigger field and should not be clipped by local render transforms.
Material Select exposes menu width behavior as part of field/menu composition, while page-level width negotiation remains caller-owned.
A menu width floor is a recipe/policy constraint for unclamped menus, not a core layout default.
Select supports match_anchor_width(false), menu_width_floor(Px), and transformed-anchor positioning probes.
The gallery exposes an unclamped menu floor toggle and a transformed clipped parent probe.
Existing diag scripts cover width-floor screenshots and transformed-anchor positioning screenshots.

checks.expected: Material Select width-floor and transformed-anchor behavior should have focused diagnostics surfaces before any overlay policy refactor.

promotion.reason: The packet should harden these scripts with sidecar predicates after the baseline field-family report exists.

facts: Material Select options can expose display text, typeahead text, supporting text, trailing supporting text, leading icons, trailing icons, selected state, and disabled state.
Two-line option layouts must preserve label/supporting/trailing alignment without forcing a design-system-agnostic list policy into core.
SelectItem supports display_text, typeahead_text, supporting_text, trailing_supporting_text, leading_icon, trailing_icon, disabled, and test_id.
The list item recipe derives selected container color through SelectStyle::menu_selected_container_color and Material select tokens.
The rich-options and item-chrome diag scripts expose multi-line option chrome and selected-row fill for future hardening.

checks.expected: Material Select rich option chrome should have a focused script and stable option chrome ids before recipe cleanup.

promotion.reason: Rich-option chrome should become a component fixture after live sidecar/screenshot evidence is attached.
